name_note: The GTDB name Actinomyces oris_A marks one part of a split of Actinomyces oris into more than one GTDB species; the cited publications use the single name Actinomyces oris.

sentences.text: The name Actinomyces oris was proposed for Actinomyces naeslundii genospecies 2, which sequences of six housekeeping genes separated from the other genospecies and from Actinomyces viscosus of rodents.
Actinomyces naeslundii, which comprised three genospecies including the one renamed Actinomyces oris, is described as an important early colonizer in the oral biofilm.
A metagenomic study of dental plaque from 96 school-aged children grouped by fluorosis severity reported Actinomyces oris significantly enriched in the moderate and severe groups.
Actinomyces oris is used as a component of standardized multi-species oral biofilm models grown in vitro on enamel discs.
